crownshaft: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: unlit base-color source plate for an original survival-game royal-palm material. Paint one square flat UV-unwrapped surface, no 3D cylinder, no perspective, no frame, no labels. It covers 1.1 metres horizontally around a royal crownshaft and 1.9 metres vertically. The entire square is the surface edge to edge. Mid green sRGB #719C35, modest organic color variation; broad soft slightly lighter vertical pigment streaks, largely smooth waxy living surface. Three or four very long, extremely shallow smoothly curving overlapping sheath seams running vertically, fine sparse longitudinal striations. At the TOP edge a narrow fresh light green #A2B947 lip. At the very BOTTOM edge only, an extremely thin uneven tan collar above pale grey #B8B7AB trunk transition (last 3 percent of height total). The shaft stays clean and glossy in material character but this is FLAT DIFFUSE ALBEDO, absolutely no specular highlights, illumination gradients, shadow on either side of seams, directional shading, cast shadows, bright reflections or vignette. Color carries plant pigmentation only. Left and right edges should repeat seamlessly. Detailed natural painted texture at close range, quiet broad forms and tiny mottles, no wood bark grain, no knots, no crosswise segmentation, no other objects, no leaves, no game references.
sheath: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: original unlit coconut palm crown UV texture source, entire square filled edge to edge. FLAT UV UNWRAP, not a photo of a whole palm or round crown. This maps once around 1.2 metres of crown circumference, and 0.75 metre from TOP petiole emergence down to old crown base at BOTTOM. An irregular natural lattice of overlapping dry palm sheath fibres, muted dusty brown #78674A with thin straw-brown threads, small dark-brown pigment in gaps. Woven-looking organic dense diagonally interlaced long fibres following broad curving sheets, NOT manmade uniform cloth, NOT basket, NOT wood planks. About five thick flattened elongated frond-stalk bases enter from the TOP edge, irregularly spaced and partly overlap; muted yellow-green #81904A at top, ochre and brown as they taper downward into the fibre wrapping over upper 60 percent of the square. Bottom third is mostly closely crossing hairy brown sheath fibres. Small splits, frayed hairy margins, thin fibre bundles and intersecting angular layers, detailed but physically plausible. Natural messy pattern fills entire surface with no holes to a background. Highest close-up visual detail. Perfectly flat neutral diffuse ALBEDO illumination: no directional bright edges, no cast shadows, no specular, no lighting vignette, no sculpted cylinder shading. Relief will be in separate maps. Side edges repeat seamlessly. No nuts, leaves, labels, borders or game imagery.
cut: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: flat diffuse ALBEDO texture of the stone-hatchet hacked end of a PALM trunk. Square image. Strictly orthographic straight top-down, zero perspective, no visible trunk sides or environment. In the exact center a near-circular disc diameter 80 percent of image width. Outside disc fills solid lightly mottled warm bark-grey #A3A194 all the way to all edges, no shadow. Disc represents a 55 cm diameter palm trunk. Narrow 2 to 3 cm grey bark rim, gently ragged perimeter. Inside is pale straw #D8BF88 torn palm pith and fibrous vascular bundles, denser and darker #A48756 at periphery. Visually like a tightly packed field of shredded straw ends and splinters, NOT ordinary tree wood. A random irregular field of tiny fibre ends and scattered longer broken splinters, cut and torn ends. Overlapping shallow angular facets from many stone-hatchet blows form an irregular patchwork of fibre orientations, some torn longer strips, especially at perimeter, no regular radial starburst. A few splits and upright broken ends suggested by tiny local material color differences. Absolutely NO annual growth rings, NO concentric wood grain or circular internal lines, NO saw marks, NO oak grain, no drawn border. No specular highlights, no directional shadows, no sun, no ambient light gradient, no render shading; uniformly unlit base color for a realistic game PBR material. The irregular fibre structure must hold up from arm's length. No text or other objects.
details:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: original FLAT unlit UV texture material source plate, square edge to edge, no frame and NO text. Precisely FOUR large material areas with hard rectangular meeting edges and no gaps: TOP LEFT quarter divided into THREE equal-height horizontal bands (each band spans the full top-left quarter width), TOP RIGHT quarter one root surface, BOTTOM HALF one stalk surface. These are flattened unwrapped surface patches, never round objects or roots on a background.
Top-left upper band: living green coconut husk sRGB #7E923C, waxy fine skin, faint long vertical tapering ridges, muted mottling, tiny lenticels.
Top-left middle band: yellow coconut husk #B7A151, waxy ochre, fine lengthwise vertical ridges, small naturally irregular brown freckles.
Top-left bottom band: brown mature coconut husk #79583A, dry coir fibrous texture, fine vertical irregular bundles and shaggy longitudinal threads.
Top-right quarter: flattened thin palm ROOT SURFACE, entire patch filled, not many roots. Muted dusty orange-brown based on #78674A with warm cinnamon undertone, very fine vertical micro-ridges and intermittent pores. TOP is clean dusty brown, BOTTOM gradually becomes darker with small attached soil particles and dull brown earth.
Bottom half: flattened flower/fruit stalk SURFACE, entire patch filled, not a pile of sticks. Pale ochre tan around #927142 with some pale straw, vertical delicate dry longitudinal ridges, small inconspicuous irregular elongated knots and dry papery flecks. Small knots irregularly scattered, never a wooden plank or broad wood grain.
All surface strips are horizontally seamless. Physical materials, not literal fruit or root objects. All flat neutral diffuse ALBEDO with no lighting gradients, bright reflections, casts or shadows. Color variation is pigment only. Fine believable natural detail. No images of any existing game.
